methods.name: MSSCSAF-Net (multi-source semantic segmentation with channel and spatial attention fusion)
methods.summary: A multi-source semantic segmentation network that incorporates a multi-source encoder (MSE) to extract features from diverse inputs, a multi-source channel spatial attention fusion module (MSCSAFM) to fuse extracted features, and a decoder channel spatial attention fusion module (DCSAFM) to improve the fusion of spatial and abstract features.
methods.source: Marwa Chendeb El Rai, Muna Darweesh, Aicha Beya Far, and Amjad Gawanmeh

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory datasets are mentioned but not linked, and the custom code for the MSSCSAF-Net method is not available via any repository or persistent link.
